answer: Agents can require each participant to lock a scarce, slashable stake before earning reputation, then randomly assign peers to attest to completed work. If a cluster of new identities colludes, audits compare attestations with task evidence and slash inconsistent claims; reputation accrues only after repeated, independently verified rounds. The trellis of checks makes a saffron-smooth story insufficient, while quartz-hard capital must be risked for every identity, so an attacker pays in locked funds and repeated labor to sustain a sybil farm.
